capabilities: Translate selected text via the DeepL API or an OpenAI-compatible LLM
Detect Chinese-to-English or English-to-Chinese direction automatically
Translate headings and paragraphs in reading mode via Tr buttons
Insert below, replace the selection, or copy the translation
Configure provider, model, timeout, fallback language, and system prompt
extras: Only Chinese↔English direction is detected; documentation is provided in both English and Chinese, with privacy details in PRIVACY.md. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later for reading-mode and Android support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in translation, and selecting text to translate on mobile is cumbersome without dedicated reading-mode controls.

requires.name: DeepL API key or DeepSeek/OpenAI-compatible API key

summary: Translation plugin that translates selected text, sentences, or paragraphs via the DeepL API or an OpenAI-compatible LLM such as DeepSeek.
